content:
使用上海交大镜像的 Lean 生态安装工具已经上线。它用于加速：

  1. install Elan
  2. install Lean toolchain (stable and nightly)
  3. install Lean 4 packages

As more and more schools begin to teach Lean and host seminars in school. However, downloading Lean in some area can be very slow. I developed a small tool to help downloading the above from mirrors.
The improvement of speed is very huge and it is quite easy to use.

https://github.com/alissa-tung/glean

Some usage

glean -install elan
glean -install lean -version 4.1.0
glean -lake-manifest-path ~/EG/lake-manifest.json -- pre download packages to `lake-packages`
3 messages were moved from this topic to #general > Discussion of glean by Johan Commelin.
